options.query:
index=windows
| timechart span=15m count by source limit=10 useother=f

index=windows
| rex field=_raw "<EventID[^>]*>(?<event_id>\d+)</EventID>"
| where event_id="4625"
| rex field=_raw "<Data[^>]*Name=.TargetUserName.[^>]*>(?<target_user>[^<]*)"
| where isnotnull(target_user) AND target_user!="-"
| stats count as failed_logons by host target_user
| sort -failed_logons

index=windows
| rex field=_raw "<EventID[^>]*>(?<event_id>\d+)</EventID>"
| where event_id="4732"
| rex field=_raw "<Data[^>]*Name=.TargetSid.[^>]*>(?<group_sid>[^<]*)"
| rex field=_raw "<Data[^>]*Name=.MemberSid.[^>]*>(?<member_sid>[^<]*)"
| rex field=_raw "<Data[^>]*Name=.SubjectUserName.[^>]*>(?<actor>[^<]*)"
| where group_sid="S-1-5-32-544"
| table _time host actor member_sid
| sort -_time

index=windows
| rex field=_raw "<EventID[^>]*>(?<event_id>\d+)</EventID>"
| where event_id="4688"
| rex field=_raw "<Data[^>]*Name=.NewProcessName.[^>]*>(?<process_name>[^<]*)"
| rex field=_raw "<Data[^>]*Name=.CommandLine.[^>]*>(?<command_line>[^<]*)"
| rex field=_raw "<Data[^>]*Name=.ParentProcessName.[^>]*>(?<parent_process>[^<]*)"
| where match(process_name,"(?i)(powershell|pwsh)\.exe$")
  AND match(command_line,"(?i)(^|[[:space:]])-(encodedcommand|enc|e)([[:space:]]|$)")
| eval command_preview=substr(command_line,1,140)
| table _time host process_name parent_process command_preview
| sort -_time

description: Centralized Windows Security monitoring — event volume, failed logons, local administrator group changes, and encoded PowerShell execution.
title: Windows Security Monitoring
